newsitem.title: USA: US to sell $14 billion of 3-, 6-mo bills April 28.
newsitem.headline: US to sell $14 billion of 3-, 6-mo bills April 28.

text.p: The Treasury Department said on Tuesday it will auction $14 billion of three- and six-month bills on April 28 to pay down $4.5 billion, as a total of $18.488 billion of bills are maturing.
The weekly bill sale will be equally divided between the two maturities. The bills will be issued on May 1. The three-month bills mature on July 31 and the six-month bills mature on October 30.
The CUSIP number for the three-month bills is 9127945G5 and for the six-month bills is 9127945S9.
